Package net.sf.jguiraffe.gui.builder.action

package net.sf.jguiraffe.gui.builder.action

The action sub package of the builder contains interfaces and classes for dealing with actions and related objects during a builder operation.

Actions represent commands that can be triggered by the user, e.g. by selecting a menu item or clicking a button. Support for menus and tool bars is also provided by this package.
